planted.item: The board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.
Maria Ek was appointed as Chief Financial Officer.
The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature.
Whether the board will accept the fee increase is still open.
The ownership of the data produced by Project Lantern was not agreed and needs legal advice.

sources.quote: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The meeting is quorate.

sources.quote: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.
sources.speaker: Anders Holm

items.text: Anders Holm declares an interest in the Northbridge project.

sources.quote: You will not take part in item four.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: Anders Holm will not take part in item four.

sources.quote: Harrowgate has sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate has sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement.

sources.quote: The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.

sources.quote: They also offer a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate offers a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.

sources.quote: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg is comfortable with the cap but finds the fee increase steep for a two year term.

sources.quote: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: Erik Nyström asks if the board could ask for a three year term at the current fee instead.

sources.quote: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss says they can ask but Harrowgate has not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.

sources.quote: the board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.

sources.quote: All in favour? That is carried unanimously.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The motion to authorise management to negotiate the renewal is carried unanimously.

sources.quote: I will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.

sources.quote: Whether we accept the fee increase at all is still open; we should come back to it once we see their answer.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Whether the board will accept the fee increase is still open.

sources.quote: The board resolves to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: Maria Ek was appointed as Chief Financial Officer.

sources.quote: I will prepare her service agreement for signature by the end of May
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature.

sources.quote: Item four, Project Lantern. Anders has left the room for this item.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: Project Lantern's budget was discussed.

sources.quote: The Northbridge team needs a budget of two point four million kronor for twenty twenty six
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: The Northbridge team needs a budget of two point four million kronor for twenty twenty six.

sources.quote: That seems reasonable given the scope we saw last quarter
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: The budget for Project Lantern was considered reasonable given the scope.

sources.quote: The board approves a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.

sources.quote: We still have not agreed who owns the data the project produces. That needs legal advice
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: The ownership of the data produced by Project Lantern was not agreed and needs legal advice.

sources.quote: Finally, the dividend. Given the investment programme, I propose no interim dividend this year
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The dividend was discussed.

sources.quote: The board resolves not to propose an interim dividend
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend.
